title: Pumpkin Spice Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Pumpkin purée and warm spices cooked into the custard with part brown sugar; less dairy to keep it scoopable.
summary: Our classic French custard turned autumnal: pumpkin purée and warm spices are cooked straight into the base, with part brown sugar for a pie-like flavour. Smooth, spiced and scoopable.

ingredients.item: plain canned pumpkin purée (not pie filling)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Beat the yolks
steps.text: In the heatproof bowl, whisk the yolks with both sugars until thick and a shade paler.

steps.title: Heat the pumpkin
steps.text: In the saucepan, whisk the pumpkin, milk, cream, spices and salt together and bring just to a simmer, stirring.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Slowly whisk half the hot pumpkin mixture into the yolks, then pour it all back into the pan.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir with the spatula over low heat until the custard reaches 77-80 °C and has clearly thickened.

steps.title: Strain and chill
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the vanilla, then press it through the sieve. Cool in the iced water and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn, then freeze for 2-4 h, until firm enough to scoop.

tips: Check the can: plain pumpkin purée, not sweetened and spiced pie filling.
A common mistake is skipping the sieve; it gives a silky finish.
Serve with crushed ginger biscuits for crunch.
storage: Freeze in a covered container for up to 2 weeks.
